title: The 2027 FHIR Mandate and the End of Manual Prior Authorization
summary: CMS-0057-F sets January 1, 2027 as the deadline for payer FHIR APIs, with turnaround standards already in effect...

content.introduction: The CMS-0057-F rule marks a massive shift toward real-time interoperability and automated prior authorization workflows.

sections.heading: API Mandates & Implementation Timelines
sections.body: Payers must expose FHIR-based APIs for Patient Access, Provider Access, and Prior Authorization by 2027.

content.conclusion: Healthcare practices must upgrade their EHR integrations now to prevent care delivery delays.

title: The State of Compliance in Autonomous Medical Billing
summary: How autonomous AI coding turns one flawed billing rule into thousands of separately penalized False Claims Act...

content.introduction: Autonomous coding systems improve efficiency, but compliance oversight remains paramount under federal guidelines.

sections.heading: Mitigating AI Algorithmic Risk
sections.body: Continuous auditing routines and human-in-the-loop validation safeguard practices against systemic claim errors.

content.conclusion: Combine AI efficiency with strict human oversight for maximum revenue compliance.

title: Live Webinar: Mastering 2026 ICD-10-CM Updates for Cleaner Claims
summary: Join our coding experts for a deep dive into the latest ICD-10-CM changes, documentation tips, and strategies to avoid claim denials.

content.introduction: Stay ahead of the October 1, 2026 ICD-10-CM updates with practical guidance from certified coding professionals.

sections.heading: Key Code Additions & Revisions
sections.body: Review the most impactful new, revised, and deleted codes affecting primary care, specialty practices, and ASCs.

sections.heading: Documentation Best Practices
sections.body: Learn how to capture the clinical details needed to support the new codes and reduce medical necessity denials.

content.conclusion: Attendees will leave with actionable checklists and coding tip sheets ready for immediate use.

title: Webinar: AI-Powered Prior Authorization – From Manual Chaos to Real-Time Approvals
summary: Discover how AI and FHIR-based automation are transforming prior authorization workflows and reducing administrative burden.

content.introduction: Prior authorization remains one of the top sources of delayed care and staff burnout. This session shows how AI can change that.

sections.heading: How AI Matches Clinical Criteria Instantly
sections.body: See live examples of AI tools that automatically check payer policies and flag missing documentation before submission.

sections.heading: Integration with EHR and PMS Systems
sections.body: Learn the technical and operational steps required to embed AI-driven prior auth into your existing technology stack.

content.conclusion: Walk away with a clear roadmap for reducing prior auth turnaround times and improving patient access.

title: Webinar: AR Recovery Playbook – Recovering Aged Receivables in 90 Days
summary: A practical, step-by-step session on identifying high-value aged claims, optimizing follow-up workflows, and maximizing cash recovery.

content.introduction: Aging accounts receivable quietly erode practice profitability. This webinar delivers proven tactics to reverse the trend.

sections.heading: Segmenting and Prioritizing Your AR
sections.body: Learn how to rank claims by payer, balance, and denial reason so your team focuses on the highest-ROI opportunities first.

sections.heading: Appeal Strategies That Actually Work
sections.body: Review real-world appeal templates, escalation paths, and secondary billing techniques that recover previously written-off balances.

content.conclusion: Participants receive a ready-to-use 90-day AR recovery action plan they can implement the next day.
